english.title: Use premises or vehicle or vessel or stall as an unlicensed sex establishment
english.standardoffencewording:

(D)_[premises,]_

english.legislation: Contrary to paragraphs 20(1)(a) and 22(1) of Schedule 3 to the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982.
english.pointstoprove:
Date and Location
knowingly used / caused / permitted the use of premises / vehicle / vessel / stall as a sex establishment
other than under / in accordance with the terms of a licence
granted under Sch 3 by the appropriate authority

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Paragraph 6(2) of Schedule 3 to the Local Government (Miscellaneous Provisions) Act 1982 provides that this offence does not apply to the sale, supply or demonstration of articles which(a) are manufactured for use primarily for the purposes of birth control; or (b) primarily relate to birth control.
